Peach Property Group AG: Public buy-back offer to the holders of the perpetual hybrid bond (CH0417376040)
Ad hoc announcement pursuant to Art. 53 LR
Total value of the offer up to CHF 10 million
"Pay-as-bid tender offer" (individual price allocation procedure; also known as an unmodified reverse Dutch auction)
The Company has set a price range of 102.0% ("Minimum Purchase Price") to 107.0% ("Maximum Purchase Price") of the nominal value of the bonds
The Purchase Price includes all accrued and deferred interest relating to these bonds
Offer period: From 3 September 2026 to 17 September 2026, 12.00 (CEST)
") announces that it is today inviting the holders of the outstanding CHF 45,974,000 perpetual hybrid bond (ISIN CH0417376040) (the "
"), issued by the Company, to tender their Bonds to the Company for purchase in exchange for cash. The Purchase will be made up to a maximum total amount of CHF 10,000,000.

The purchase will be conducted by means of a "pay-as-bid tender offer" (an individual price allocation procedure, also known as an unmodified reverse Dutch auction). Bondholders may specify, within the price range set out in the terms of the offer, the price at which they are prepared to sell their Bonds to the Company. Where an offer is accepted, the purchase price will correspond to the price specified by the respective bondholder. There will therefore be no uniform purchase price for all accepted Bonds. Once the offer period has expired, the Company will rank the bondholders' offers, starting with the lowest. When accepting the bondholders' offers, the Company will give priority to the most favourable offers and will continue to purchase Bonds until the total purchase amount has been reached.
The offer closes on 17 September 2026 at 12.00 (CEST), unless it is extended, amended or terminated early in accordance with the terms of the offer.
The offer is subject to the terms and conditions of the Information Memorandum to be published today (the
The Information Memorandum is available on the Company's website under 'News – Presentations'. A FAQ document can also be found there.
Gerald Klinck, Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer
Rosenberg Strategic Communications GmbH & Co. KG

Peach Property Group is a property investor specialising in residential property in Germany. The group boasts many years of experience, expertise and quality. Innovative solutions tailored to tenants' needs, strong partnerships and a broad value chain round out its profile, whilst digitalisation and sustainability shape its day-to-day operations. The portfolio comprises high-yield properties, typically located in German Tier II cities within the catchment areas of metropolitan regions. Its activities therefore span the entire value chain, from site evaluation and acquisition to active asset management and the letting or sale of property. In addition, the group develops selected properties in Switzerland for sale as flats, with the 'Peninsula Wädenswil' development project being the most recent such project.

Peach Property Group AG is headquartered in Zurich and has its German group headquarters in Cologne. Peach Property Group AG is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (PEAN, ISIN CH0118530366). The Board of Directors comprises Michael Zahn (Chairman), Cyrill Schneuwly, Beat Frischknecht, Urs Meister and Alexander Hesse.
Further information is available at https://peachproperty.com.
